name: native-reason-walk-memory
goal: Bound memory retained by long reason-history walks while preserving every explanation result

evidence: Run 40421510002 on commit 604b8f9 reproduced the native reserve timeout at 1742 MiB available against the 2048 MiB minimum; reason history keeps intermediate revisions until traversal ends.

test/history-reason-steps.e2e.test.ts covers only a two-commit chain and asserts reason correctness, but not the shape of loaded historical sides or retained facts. Extend that standardized scenario to verify history loaders return only hashes and symbol blocks needed by requiredReasons.
